title: Fonts pack
description: Install a good set of fonts: system fonts with emoji and Arabic/Latin coverage, and popular programming fonts.
author: Tux Store

download_mb.label: Download size
download_mb.shell: pacman -Si ttf-dejavu ttf-liberation noto-fonts noto-fonts-emoji 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Download Size/ {v=$4; u=$5; if (u=="KiB") v/=1024; else if (u=="GiB") v*=1024; else if (u=="B") v/=1048576; t+=v} END {printf "%d\n", t+0.5}'

installed_mb.label: Installed size
installed_mb.shell: pacman -Si ttf-dejavu ttf-liberation noto-fonts noto-fonts-emoji 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Installed Size/ {v=$4; u=$5; if (u=="KiB") v/=1024; else if (u=="GiB") v*=1024; else if (u=="B") v/=1048576; t+=v} END {printf "%d\n", t+0.5}'

info.note: Sizes are read from your package database. Packages you already have are skipped.

welcome.title: Fonts pack
message: Missing letters, boxes instead of emoji, or an ugly terminal font?
The basic set gives you DejaVu, Liberation, Noto (wide language coverage, including Arabic) and Noto Emoji. The coding set adds JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Hack and Cascadia Code.

choose.title: What do you want to install?
choose.message: You can run this again later to add more.

options.label: System fonts + emoji
hint: DejaVu, Liberation, Noto and Noto Emoji.

options.label: Programming fonts
hint: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Hack and Cascadia Code.

options.label: Everything
hint: System fonts plus the programming fonts.

set.pkgs: ttf-dejavu ttf-liberation noto-fonts noto-fonts-emoji ttf-jetbrains-mono ttf-fira-code ttf-hack ttf-cascadia-code

command.label: Checking your system…
shell: [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] || { echo "Tux Store is running as root. Start it as a normal user; it asks for the password only when needed."; exit 0; }
for t in pkexec pacman; do
command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The required tool '$t' is missing."; exit 0; }
[ ! -e /var/lib/pacman/db.lck ] || { echo "pacman is locked (/var/lib/pacman/db.lck exists). Another package manager may be running. Wait for it to finish, then try again."; exit 0; }

command.label: Looking at what is already installed…
shell: pacman -Si "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue      # not in your repositories: handled below

already_done.title: Already installed
message: Everything in this set is already on your system, so nothing was changed.

done.title: Fonts installed

command.label: Checking your system…
shell: [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] || { echo "Tux Store is running as root. Start it as a normal user; it asks for the password only when needed."; exit 0; }
for t in pkexec pacman; do
command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The required tool '$t' is missing."; exit 0; }
[ ! -e /var/lib/pacman/db.lck ] || { echo "pacman is locked (/var/lib/pacman/db.lck exists). Another package manager may be running. Wait for it to finish, then try again."; exit 0; }

un_run.title: Removing Fonts pack…
un_run.message: Please don't turn off the computer until I'm finished.

commands.label: Removing the codec packages
shell: # Two passes: a package may only become removable after another one is gone.
if pacman -Rns --noconfirm "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "removed $p"; elif [ "$pass" = 2 ]; then echo "kept $p (other software needs it)"; fi

un_done.title: Codecs removed
un_done.message: The packages this add-on installed were removed. Packages that other software needs were kept.

un_failed.title: Removal failed
message: ${last_failed}
${last_output}
